Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: Second Bite is a non-profit platform that helps shops sell their end-of-day surplus at a lower price. This page says what personal data we collect, why, how long we keep it, who can see it and what your rights are, under Vietnam's Personal Data Protection Law 2025 and Decree 52/2013/NĐ-CP.

sections.title: 1. Who is responsible for your data
paragraphs: Data controller: to be added (name of the organisation or person, address).
Privacy contact: to be added.

sections.title: 2. What we collect and why
paragraphs: Browsing and searching need no account. When you search around a place, it is used only to work out distances for that search and is not stored.
Account: your email address, to send you sign-in codes and recognise you next time; a display name, so the shop can call you at the handover.
Signing in with Google (coming soon): your Google identifier, email address, name and profile picture, which Google shares when you agree, to sign you in and show your name.
Sign-in session: a random token that keeps you signed in; we store only its hash and when it was last used.
Sellers: the shop's name, address, map location and phone, and the email addresses of its owner and staff, so the shop can post and customers can find it.
Photos: dish and shop photos uploaded by sellers. Each is written again in two sizes without any embedded information such as where it was taken or the camera.
Orders (coming soon): dishes, quantities, collection time and status, so the shop can prepare them and each person's daily limit can be kept.
Emails sent: recipient, kind of email and the provider's message id, to know whether an email arrived.
Technical logs: the time, path and result of each request, to find and fix faults; they never hold email addresses, codes or passwords.

sections.title: 3. How long we keep it
paragraphs: Sign-in codes: deleted once used, when a newer one is requested, or a day after they were sent at the latest.
Sessions: end after 30 days without use; deleted when you sign out.
Photos uploaded but never used for a dish or a shop: deleted after a day.
Accounts, shops, posted dishes and orders: kept until you delete your account or ask us to delete them, except what the law requires us to keep longer.

When you delete your account: the account, its sessions, its Google link, sign-in codes and the record of the emails we sent you are deleted at once; your place in shops and the photos you never used go within minutes. Posted dishes, their photos and shop photos belong to the shop and stay, no longer linked to you; a shop you own is closed. Your orders: your name, phone number and consent to Zalo are taken off them, and the chats with the shop are deleted; the shop keeps the order number, dishes, amount and status for its records, no longer linked to you.

sections.title: 4. Who can see your data
paragraphs: Sellers see your display name and your orders with their shop, never your email address. Customers see a shop's and its dishes' public details.
Second Bite's admins see data when operating and supporting the service requires it.

Processors acting for us: our hosting provider (Amazon Web Services; server location: to be added), our email provider (Brevo), and Google when you choose to sign in with Google. If data is kept outside Vietnam, we will say so here.
We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
paragraphs: You may know about, see, correct and ask us to delete your data; withdraw your consent; ask us to restrict processing; and complain, under the Personal Data Protection Law 2025.
You can delete your account yourself in the app (Account → Account settings → Delete account) or on the web at /delete-account, after typing the code we email to the account's address.

You can change your display name yourself. For anything else, write to the contact in section 1; we answer within the time the law sets, and if we cannot delete something for a legitimate reason, we tell you why.

sections.title: 6. Cookies and browser storage
paragraphs: A session cookie (coming soon), to keep you signed in.
A language cookie, remembering Vietnamese or English for a year.
A mark in the browser's storage, remembering that you closed the introduction.
We use no advertising cookies and no third-party tracking.

sections.title: 7. Protecting your data
paragraphs: Connections are encrypted; sign-in codes and sessions are stored only as hashes; access is checked on the server for every request. If a breach occurs, we will notify as the law requires.

sections.title: 8. Children
paragraphs: Second Bite is for people aged 16 and over. If you are younger, use it with a parent or guardian.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: When the policy changes, we update the date at the top and tell you before a change that affects your rights takes effect.

Privacy.description: What personal data Second Bite collects, why, for how long, who sees it and your rights, under Vietnam's 2025 Personal Data Protection Law.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: These terms are the agreement between you and Second Bite when you use Second Bite's website and app, as a customer or as a seller.

sections.title: 1. What Second Bite is
paragraphs: Second Bite is a non-profit platform connecting shops with end-of-day surplus to customers who want it at a lower price. Second Bite takes no commission on a shop's sales.
Operator: to be added (name, address, registration and licence if any).
The sale of food is between the customer and the shop. Second Bite provides the place to post, find and order; it neither sells nor inspects food.

sections.title: 2. Accounts
paragraphs: You can browse and search without an account. You sign in to order, to follow a shop, or to post for a shop.
Keep the mailbox and Google account you sign in with secure, and do not sign in for someone else.

sections.title: 3. Sellers' responsibilities
paragraphs: Post only genuine surplus, never food still needed for normal service.
Describe the food, quantity, original price and price truthfully; the price must be at least Second Bite's minimum discount below the original price (20% at present).
You are responsible for the food's quality, safety and allergen information, and for checking it at the handover.
Photos and text you post must be yours or yours to use; you allow Second Bite to show them on the platform.

sections.title: 4. Customers' responsibilities
paragraphs: Collect within the dish's window; an order not collected may be recorded and affect later orders.
Read the description, especially allergen information, and ask the shop when unsure. Surplus food may differ slightly from its photo.
Each person may order a limited number of items a day, so surplus reaches more people.

sections.title: 5. Prices, payment and cancellation
paragraphs: Prices shown are the shop's; third-party fees, if any, are shown separately before you order.
During the pilot, you pay the shop directly when you collect. Cancellation and refunds: to be added when ordering opens.

sections.title: 6. What is not allowed
paragraphs: Posting false, unlawful or someone else's content; ordering without meaning to collect; interfering with the system or using someone else's account.
Second Bite may hide a dish, or suspend a shop or an account that breaks these terms.

sections.title: 7. Limits of liability
paragraphs: Second Bite works to keep the service running but does not promise it is always available. To the extent the law allows, Second Bite is not responsible for the quality of food a shop sells; complaints about food go to the shop, and Second Bite helps both sides resolve them.

sections.title: 8. Changes and governing law
paragraphs: When these terms change, we update the date at the top and tell you beforehand if a change affects your rights.
These terms are governed by Vietnamese law. Disputes are first settled by negotiation, then as the law provides.
Contact: to be added.
